content: सूरिः [सू-क्रिन्] .²1 The sun. .²2 A learned or wise man, a sage; अथवा कृतवाग्द्वारे वंशेऽस्मिन् पूर्वसूरिभिः <ls>R. 1. 4</ls>; <ls>Śi. 14. 21</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 1. 1. 1</ls>. .²3 A priest. .²4 A worshipper. .²5 A title of respect given to Jaina teachers; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} मल्लिनाथसूरि. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Kṛṣṇa. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of Bṛhaspati.
